processing: 2026-11-06: per-character continuation of the licensed performances at commit 7243ac1. Mono PCM16 44100 Hz; FFmpeg rubberband pitch (duration preserved), HP 100 Hz / LP 2600-4100 Hz; independent recorded human, throat, deer, wet and chain layers documented per take. Soft crest x/sqrt(1+(x/(drive*RMS))^2), drive 1.45-1.8, two 3000 Hz smoothing stages, 16/75 ms fades. No stolen game audio. Additional sources with licenses inherited through prior_take and original provenance; new public HQ previews explicitly identified. Technical shaping is not a listening approval.

prior_provenance.processing: Mono 44100 Hz PCM16. Original performances retained except death; added independent human/throat performances for variants and movement/recovery. Modest pitch changes and quiet short room/helmet reflections as recorded per take. Crest shaping x/sqrt(1+(x/(2.7*RMS))^2), two 2800 Hz smoothing stages, 16/75 ms fades, peak <= .58; RMS targets .080 presence, .095 movement/recovery, .115 pain/alert, .125 death, .145 spells/effort. Runtime gain and falloff are in recipe data. No game audio copied.
